notes: Assumptions that move the number: 800 g bone-in shin yields ~65 % meat (520 g); 500 g dried sugar beans counted dry (83 g a bowl, ~280 kcal). The checker warns that macros give ~17 % less energy than the kcal total. That is fibre: USDA's 335 kcal for dry cranberry beans includes 24.7 g fibre / 100 g at the legume Atwater factor. Counting fibre at 2 kcal/g instead would give ~470 kcal a bowl. Compared against: FatSecret generic bean soup at 137 kcal a cup and a community bean soup with potato at 233 kcal a serving. A boontjiesop bowl is ~650 g (about 2.7 cups), which gives ~370 kcal at the generic density. Ours is higher because it carries far more beans than a generic bean soup, plus 87 g of beef a bowl.
